components.name: Grid
components.description:
Place columns inside a row and container. Responsive column classes use the
configured breakpoint name, for example `.col-md-6`.
components.markup:
One third
Two thirds

components.name: Sticky footer
components.description:
Apply `.has-sticky-footer` to the body or another page wrapper. Its direct
`main` child expands to fill the available viewport height.
components.markup:
Header
Page content
Footer

components.name: Typography
components.description:
Headings, lead text, inline code, highlighted text, and quotations inherit the
configured COCO type scale and colors.
components.markup:
Build websites with COCO

A lightweight, JavaScript-free CSS framework.

Use semantic HTML and document code with SassDoc.

Styles should support the content.

components.name: Links
components.description:
Links use the configured foreground and hover colors. Keep meaningful link
text and use buttons, rather than links, for actions that do not navigate.
components.markup: Read the COCO documentation

components.name: Responsive media
components.description:
Images scale down without distortion. Iframes fill their parent, so place an
iframe inside a container with an appropriate aspect ratio. A `figure` adds
space before its centered `figcaption`.

components.name: Divider
components.description:
Use a thematic break to separate related content. The element receives the
configured border color and no default raised border.
components.markup:
Content before the break.

Content after the break.

components.name: Attributed quotation
components.description:
`.quote` groups a quotation and attribution with consistent spacing. Use a
`blockquote` for the quoted content and a `figcaption` for its source.

components.name: Buttons
components.description:
Use a variant class to communicate an action's emphasis. Buttons support small,
large, block, icon, focus, and disabled states.
components.markup: <button class="btn {{ modifier_class }}" type="button">Button</button>

modifiers.description: Primary action with an elevated shadow.
Square padding for an icon-only button; provide an accessible name.

components.name: Form controls
components.description:
Text fields, text areas, and selects share sizing, focus, validation, and disabled
states. Always associate a visible label with each control.
components.markup:
<label class="form-label" for="kss-email">Email address</label>
<input class="form-control {{ modifier_class }}" id="kss-email" type="email" placeholder="hello@example.com">

components.name: Checks and radios
components.description:
`.form-check` aligns a custom checkbox or radio with its label. The control
supports checked, indeterminate, focused, disabled, small, and large states.

modifiers.description: Vertically center the control and label.
Align the control with the first line.

components.name: Switches
components.description:
Use a switch for an immediately applied on/off setting. Preserve the native
checkbox so keyboard, focus, checked, disabled, and right-to-left behavior work.

modifiers.description: Put the label and switch at opposite edges.
Vertically center the control and label.
Align the control with the first line.

components.name: File input
components.description:
The native file input receives a button-like file selector. It retains native
focus and supports the standard small, large, and disabled input states.
components.markup:
<label class="form-label" for="kss-file">Upload an image</label>
<input class="form-file {{ modifier_class }}" id="kss-file" type="file" accept="image/*">

components.name: Range input
components.description:
The range control provides a consistent track, thumb, focus ring, and disabled
state while preserving the native value and keyboard behavior.
components.markup:
<label class="form-label" for="kss-range">Volume</label>
<input class="form-range" id="kss-range" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="60">

components.name: Fieldset and legend
components.description:
Group related controls with a fieldset and describe the group with its first
legend. Consecutive fieldsets receive additional vertical separation.
components.markup: Contact preference

components.name: Form groups
components.description:
`.form-group` stacks a label, control, description, and feedback. Check groups
can flow horizontally or vertically; row groups become two-column layouts when
their named container is wide enough; stacked groups join adjacent controls.
components.markup: Enter your public display name.

modifiers.description: Wrap checks in a horizontal row.
Join adjacent controls into one visual group.

components.name: Validation feedback
components.description:
Place `.field-feedback` after its related control and connect the message with
`aria-describedby`. Match valid or invalid feedback to the control state.
components.markup: Username is available.

components.name: Input group label
components.description:
`.form-group-label` visually joins short text to a neighboring control. Use it
inside a stacked form group and provide an accessible label for the input.
components.markup: €

components.name: Mixed form row
components.description:
`.form-row--mixed` arranges different-width form groups in a wrapping row. Set
`--inline-size` on a child group when it needs a preferred width.

components.name: Form description
components.description:
Use `.form-description` for persistent help text and associate it with the
control using `aria-describedby`.
components.markup:
<label class="form-label" for="kss-password">Password</label>
<input class="form-control" id="kss-password" type="password" aria-describedby="kss-password-help">
<small class="form-description" id="kss-password-help">Use at least 12 characters.</small>

components.name: Form label
components.description:
`.form-label` provides consistent label typography. Connect it to its control
with `for` and the control's matching `id`.
components.markup:
<label class="form-label" for="kss-labelled-control">Email address</label>
<input class="form-control" id="kss-labelled-control" type="email">

components.name: Tables
components.description:
Wrap wide tables in `.table-responsive`. Variants can add stripes, hover
feedback, compact spacing, rounded cells, or remove borders.

modifiers.description: Align the first and last cells with surrounding content.

components.name: Emoji effects
components.description: Emoji can be normalized with flat, grayscale, gray, or black rendering.
components.markup: 📥

modifiers.description: Increase contrast and flatten the colors.

components.name: Image filters
components.description:
Wrap an image in `.filter` and add one effect class. The wrapper clips generated
overlays correctly when it has the same dimensions as its image.

modifiers.description: Soft pastel light with a warm cast.
A bright center and darker edges.
High contrast with a metallic tint.
Faded Polaroid color with warm yellow.

components.name: Screen-reader-only content
components.description:
`.sr-only` visually hides content while retaining it for assistive technology.
Use it for context that is apparent visually but otherwise needs a text label.
Elements focused with `tabindex="-1"` have their redundant outline removed.

components.name: Hidden content
components.description:
`.hidden` and the native `[hidden]` attribute remove an element from layout and
the accessibility tree. Use `.sr-only` instead when assistive tools still need
the content.
components.markup: This explanatory text may be hidden.

components.name: Heading utilities
components.description:
Use `.h1` through `.h6` when semantic heading level and visual size need to
differ. These classes change font size only; choose the HTML element by document
structure first.
components.markup: Heading-sized text

components.name: Copyable text
components.description:
`.copy` selects all of an element's text when users interact with it. It is
useful for identifiers and short values that are commonly copied.
components.markup: @blockchainhub/coco

components.name: Version indicator
components.description:
Add `.coco.version` to an element to insert the framework version with CSS.
Include a readable prefix in the element because the generated content alone
should not carry essential information.
components.markup: COCO version
